spec_match.rationale: Inspects the exact IDL surfaces (HTMLCameraElement, HTMLMicrophoneElement, setConstraints, track/error members) and demonstrates the trusted-activation contract by showing that synthetic clicks confer no success.

interactive.rationale: Inspect, synthetic-click, and clear controls all mutate the live summary and event log; both capability elements are on the page and wired to track/cancel/error listeners.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Delivers the promised comparison of both elements, exact IDL members, and event lifecycles.

edge_cases.rationale: Unsupported browsers get an explicit absent-interfaces message with flag-enable steps; the synthetic-click path documents that no success is inferred, guarding against a false-success probe.

conformance.rationale: The new v153 feature suite encodes the same interface/member contract the console inspects. Predecessor suite untouched.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Feature harness run (responsive-check, --no-server) passed desktop+mobile after final edits, screenshots read. CDP sweep verified the auto-run inspection, synthetic-click log line, clear, and re-inspect, with zero console errors/exceptions/failed requests.

telemetry_health.rationale: Each inspection emits showcaseTelemetry.assert('capability-interfaces', ...) with the exact typeof results.

design_system.rationale: Design-system variables only; the log <pre> uses the black-on-ivory inverse pairing; focus-visible outlines are explicit.

accessibility.rationale: Native buttons, aria-live summary output, and an aria-labelled event log; refile replaced implicit id-globals with explicit element lookups to avoid host-global collisions.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Covered by the feature harness run: no horizontal overflow on either class; the two-panel grid collapses via auto-fit minmax and controls wrap full-width under 640px.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible live status output for feature detection probes and async API results
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce asynchronous result state through a live region and keep repeated content in list/log structures with accessible names.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The inspection summary is an aria-live <output>; the event log is an aria-labelled <pre> appended line-by-line.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible live status output for feature detection probes and async API results
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Avoid relying on implicit window id-globals for behaviour wiring.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The v153 refile switched inspect/synthetic/clear/summary from implicit id-globals to explicit querySelector lookups with addEventListener.

summary: v153 refile of the v152 constraint-and-event console for the Chrome 153 shipping milestone. Beyond milestone updates it removes implicit id-global wiring and adds an explicit absent-interfaces explanation naming the CameraAndMicrophoneElements flag. Verified with the responsive harness and a CDP interaction sweep (zero console errors).
